feature_contract.goal: Bound diagnostic R28 slow-frame logging so a spike/tier storm cannot synchronously stall Present while retaining worst-frame per-thread CPU, draw serial, threshold counts, and analyzer-readable 5-second telemetry.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R28 active frame pacing diagnostics in R26 game renderer; preserve world/eye drawing, HUD, F11, SkyGlow, Reset semantics, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R28 previously performed render-thread spdlog::warn on every new 1-second cooldown or more severe slow-frame tier. During 300ms bursts this could emit several blocking formatted warnings within a single frame window, despite existing R32 spike log coalescing. The R28 hook is a separate remaining call site; p95/p99 hardware gain unmeasured.
trace_stages: OutRun PresentDestR27 brackets original R23 Present with source QPC and frame serial/TopLevelDrawSerial.
R28RecordActiveFramePacing samples render-thread CPU and source frame dips, stores the exact slowest interval rather than logging synchronously.
One five-second diagnostic report preserves original regex-compatible frame/CPU metadata and histogram, then zeroes epoch state for subsequent XR sessions.
subcomponents: Replace cooldown/tier-triggered render-thread dip warnings with an exact worst-frame snapshot, retaining all 60/50/40/30 thresholds.
Report one analyzer-compatible dip per 5-second sampling window, preserving draw/serial/CPU attribution and telemetry disable/re-enable isolation.
Extend the existing Win32-active pacing verifier with fail-closed structural gates, mutation and seeded spike storms.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Any number of severe source-frame dips generates at most one worst-dip warning per finished 5-second window; never on per-frame tier escalation.
Machine-readable historical R28 dip format, CPU/draw/serial context, p95/p99 counters and disable-re-enable Reset epochs are preserved with protected stereo rendering unchanged.
Existing plus new destructive checks and Windows DX9Ex Active policy/game/host/full-chain/package and Domain Isolation all pass the material exact SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R28RecordActiveFramePacing() invoked spdlog::warn inside every one-second or greater-tier slow-frame branch in PresentDestR27 diagnostic render-thread callback.
diagnosis.root_cause: Diagnostic warning formatting and logging are synchronous on game Present thread, causing self-inflicted frame-time amplification when R28 dips persist or escalate.
source_trace: Game submits draw and original R23 Present from R27 wrapper.
QPC and GetThreadTimes derive R28 dip classification, serial, per-frame CPU/prep timing.
R28 diagnostic window flush and session Analyzer receive exactly one highest-duration event.
alternatives_rejected: Simply increasing cooldown preserves a blocking logger call inside a slow frame.
Deleting warnings loses attribution needed to isolate VR stalls.
Lowering render resolution is not a root-cause fix and harms image fidelity.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Replace per-event logger with bounded worstDip struct and preserve legacy warning fields at five-second flush; source-only expected benefit, no runtime FPS claims.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing seven destructive guards plus one-warning structural check, epoch reset validation and 48 seeded 300-frame burst models; exact-SHA CI pending.

performance_evidence: Eliminates all R28 synchronous per-frame dip warnings. End-to-end Quest3 p95/p99 remains unmeasured; no performance uplift claimed.

material.description: R28 C++ worst-dip 5-second backpressure and active diagnostic verifier

validation_evidence.targeted: R28 active frame-pacing bounded logger, 48 seeded spike-burst models, 7 legacy destructive checks and new epoch/peak-negative guards were executed in exact-SHA policy CI.
validation_evidence.runtime: Quest3/VDXR hardware FPS/optical validation not performed.
